resources.string: In the phone\'s calendar or as a link to subscribe to
See the meals of the coming weeks next to your other plans. Choose one way or both; both are off until you turn them on.
The demo\'s meals stay in the app. Log in to your Tandoor server to show your own meal plan in the calendar.
Log in to your Tandoor server to show the meal plan in the calendar.

Tandem writes the meals into a calendar of its own, “%1$s”, on this phone only. It works without a connection and is updated at least once a day and whenever the plan changes. Meals with a time for their meal type get that time, the others are all-day.
Turning it off removes the calendar and its meals from the phone. Logging out does too.
Tandem needs access to the calendar to write the meals there. Nothing else in your calendars is read or changed.
Tandem can no longer update the calendar
Access to the calendar was turned off. Allow it again, or turn the option off.
The phone\'s calendar did not answer
The meals could not be written. Tandem tries again later; you can also update now.

An address that calendar apps such as Google Calendar can subscribe to. Your Tandoor server sends the meal plan straight to the calendar, also on other devices. It uses a key of its own that can only read the meal plan.
Anyone with the link can read your meal plan
Share it only with people you trust. If it has spread, make a new link: the old one stops working.
No calendar app on this phone opens the link itself. Copy it and add it in the calendar app or on its website (in Google Calendar: “Other calendars” → “From URL”).
The link needs a key of its own on the server. Ask someone in the household, or use the phone\'s calendar above.
This server cannot be subscribed to
This version of Tandoor cannot take the key in the address, so calendar apps cannot subscribe. Use the phone\'s calendar above.
The old link stops working at once. Calendars that subscribe to it must subscribe to the new one.
The link stops working at once and calendars that subscribe to it no longer get the meal plan.
The meals are now in the calendar “%1$s”.
The calendar was removed from the phone.
The calendar is up to date.
Without access to the calendar the meals cannot be shown there.
New link ready. The old one no longer works.
The server could not be reached. Try again when you are connected.
That did not work. Try again later.
The calendar could not be written. Try again later.
